topics.title: Kinh nghiệm kỹ thuật
topics.description: Giải thích công nghệ và cách bạn làm việc, kèm ví dụ thật.

units.title: Tell me about yourself
units.scenario: A job interview for a professional role.
units.goal: Trả lời theo 3 ý: bạn là ai hiện nay, bạn đã làm được gì, vì sao bạn muốn vị trí này.
units.greeting: Hi, thanks for coming in today.
units.closing: Thank you, that's all my questions for today. It was nice talking to you.
units.vocab: software developer, Java, backend, microservices, payment system, chat application, booking system, achievement, responsible for.

questions.ask: To start, could you tell me a little about yourself?
questions.simple: Let's keep it simple. What is your job, and how long have you done it?

questions.ask: What are you mainly responsible for in your current role?
questions.simple: What do you do in your job? What are your main tasks?

questions.ask: What is one achievement you're proud of?
questions.simple: Tell me about one thing you did at work that went well.

questions.ask: What do you enjoy most about your work?
questions.simple: What do you like about your job?

questions.ask: What kind of role are you looking for next?
questions.simple: What kind of job do you want next?

questions.ask: And why are you interested in this position?
questions.simple: Why do you want this job?

phrases.say: I've been working as a ... for ... years.
I'm responsible for ...
One of my main achievements was ...
What I enjoy most about my work is ...
I'm looking for a role where I can ...
match: i am looking for a role

phrases.say: That's why I'm interested in this position.
match: that is why i am interested

units.title: Your current project
units.scenario: A job interview for a backend developer role. The interviewer asks about the candidate's current project.
units.goal: Kể về dự án hiện tại theo thứ tự: sản phẩm làm gì, hệ thống gồm những gì, phần bạn phụ trách, khó khăn, điều bạn tự hào.
units.greeting: Let's talk about the project you're working on now.
units.closing: Thanks, that gives me a good picture of your project.
units.vocab: Spring Boot, microservices, REST API, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, users, sprint, feature.

questions.ask: Can you describe the project you're working on right now?
questions.simple: What does your current project do?

questions.ask: How is the system designed? What are the main parts?
questions.simple: What technologies does the project use?

questions.ask: Which part of the project are you responsible for?
questions.simple: What do you build in this project?

questions.ask: What has been the biggest challenge in this project so far?
questions.simple: What is difficult in this project?

questions.ask: What are you most proud of in this project?
questions.simple: Which part of your work in this project do you like most?

phrases.say: Right now I'm working on ..., which helps ...
The system is built with ... and consists of ...
I'm in charge of ...
The biggest challenge was ...
I'm especially proud of ...

units.title: Career goals and motivation
units.scenario: A job interview. The interviewer asks about the candidate's motivation and career plans.
units.goal: Nói vì sao bạn muốn đổi việc (theo hướng tích cực, không chê công ty cũ), bạn muốn học thêm gì, và kế hoạch vài năm tới.
units.greeting: Now I'd like to understand your career plans.
units.closing: Thank you, it's good to know what you're aiming for.
units.vocab: career, senior developer, tech lead, software architect, cloud, mentor, challenge, growth, opportunity, product company, outsourcing.

questions.ask: Why are you looking for a new job at the moment?
questions.simple: Why do you want to change jobs?

questions.ask: What skills would you like to develop in your next role?
questions.simple: What do you want to learn next?

questions.ask: Where do you see yourself in five years?
questions.simple: What job do you want in five years?

questions.ask: What kind of team do you work best in?
questions.simple: What kind of team do you like to work in?

questions.ask: Why should we choose you for this position?
questions.simple: What makes you a good fit for this job?

phrases.say: I'm looking for a new challenge where I can ...
match: i am looking for a new

phrases.say: I'd like to get better at ...
match: i'd like to get better at
i would like to get better at

phrases.say: In five years, I see myself as ...
I work best in a team that ...
I think I'm a good fit because ...

units.title: Java and Spring experience
units.scenario: A technical job interview for a Java backend developer. The interviewer asks about the candidate's experience with Java and Spring.
units.goal: Giải thích công nghệ bạn dùng hằng ngày, mỗi ý kèm một ví dụ cụ thể bạn đã dùng nó để làm gì.
units.greeting: Let's move on to your technical experience.
units.closing: Great, thank you for walking me through your stack.
units.vocab: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA, Hibernate, REST API, Maven, Gradle, JUnit, dependency injection, annotation, JWT, OAuth2, Java 17, Java 21, virtual threads, records.

questions.ask: Which technologies do you use most in your daily work?
questions.simple: What languages and tools do you use every day?

questions.ask: What have you built with Spring Boot?
questions.simple: Tell me about one service you made with Spring Boot.

questions.ask: Can you explain dependency injection in simple words?
questions.simple: Why does Spring create objects for you?

questions.ask: How do you handle security in your APIs?
questions.simple: How do you protect your API?

questions.ask: Is there a newer Java feature you like using?
questions.simple: What do you like about new Java versions?

phrases.say: In my daily work, I mainly use ...
I've used Spring Boot to build ...
Simply put, ... means ...
We secure our APIs with ...
One feature I really like is ..., because ...

units.title: Designing microservices
units.scenario: A technical job interview for a backend developer. The interviewer asks how the candidate designs and runs microservices.
units.goal: Mô tả kiến trúc theo thứ tự: chia thành những service nào, chúng giao tiếp ra sao, xử lý thế nào khi một service lỗi. Nói cả ưu và nhược điểm.
units.greeting: I'd like to talk about system design.
units.closing: Thank you, that was a clear explanation of your architecture.
units.vocab: microservices, monolith, REST, gRPC, Kafka, RabbitMQ, message queue, API gateway, service discovery, circuit breaker, retry, timeout, eventual consistency, Docker, Kubernetes.

questions.ask: Have you worked with microservices? How was the system split into services?
questions.simple: How many services did your system have, and what did each one do?

questions.ask: How do the services communicate with each other?
questions.simple: Do your services call each other directly, or send messages?

questions.ask: What happens when one service goes down?
questions.simple: What do you do if one service stops working?

questions.ask: What are the downsides of microservices compared to a monolith?
questions.simple: What is hard about microservices?

questions.ask: If you could redesign that system, what would you change?
questions.simple: What would you do differently next time?

phrases.say: The system was split into ... services, for example ...
They communicate through ...
To handle failures, we use ...
The main trade-off is ...
If I could do it again, I would ...
match: if i could do it again

units.title: Database and performance
units.scenario: A technical job interview for a backend developer. The interviewer asks about databases and performance problems.
units.goal: Kể cách bạn tìm ra chỗ chậm (đo trước rồi mới sửa), cách bạn sửa, và kết quả bằng con số.
units.greeting: Let's talk about databases and performance.
units.closing: Thanks, it's clear you've dealt with real performance issues.
units.vocab: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, index, query, slow query, execution plan, N+1 problem, Redis, cache, connection pool, transaction, latency, response time, monitoring, Grafana.

questions.ask: Which databases have you worked with, and how did you choose between them?
questions.simple: Which databases do you use?

questions.ask: Tell me about a slow query or a slow API you had to fix. How did you find the cause?
questions.simple: How do you find out why something is slow?

questions.ask: What did you do to make it faster?
questions.simple: How did you fix it?

questions.ask: When do you decide to add a cache?
questions.simple: Why and when do you use a cache like Redis?

questions.ask: How did you check that the fix really worked?
questions.simple: How did you know it was faster?

phrases.say: We chose ... because ...
First, I checked ... and found that ...
I fixed it by ...
A cache makes sense when ...
We measured ... before and after the change.

units.title: Testing and code quality
units.scenario: A technical job interview for a backend developer. The interviewer asks about testing and code quality.
units.goal: Nói rõ bạn test những gì và vì sao, team bạn review code thế nào, và một lần test giúp bắt được bug.
units.greeting: Now let's talk about code quality.
units.closing: Thank you, I like how you think about quality.
units.vocab: unit test, integration test, JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, code coverage, code review, pull request, SonarQube, CI pipeline, refactoring, clean code, legacy code.

questions.ask: How do you usually test your code?
questions.simple: What kinds of tests do you write?

questions.ask: What makes a good unit test, in your opinion?
questions.simple: How do you know a test is good?

questions.ask: How does code review work in your team?
questions.simple: What do you check when you review code?

questions.ask: Can you tell me about a time a test caught a serious bug?
questions.simple: Did a test ever find an important bug for you?

questions.ask: How do you deal with old code that has no tests?
questions.simple: What do you do with old code without tests?

phrases.say: I usually write ... tests for ...
A good test should ...
In our team, every pull request ...
Thanks to that test, we caught ... before release.
Before changing it, I first ...

units.title: A problem you solved (STAR)
units.scenario: A behavioural job interview about a difficult problem the candidate solved at work.
units.goal: Trả lời theo STAR: Situation (bối cảnh), Task (nhiệm vụ), Action (hành động), Result (kết quả).
units.closing: Thank you, that was a clear example. That's all from me.
units.vocab: bug, production issue, deadline, performance, database, deployment, customer, as a result, reduced, improved.

questions.ask: Can you tell me about a difficult problem you solved at work? What was the situation?
questions.simple: Think of one problem at work. What happened?

questions.ask: What exactly was your task?
questions.simple: What did you need to do?

questions.ask: What did you do to solve it?
questions.simple: What steps did you take?

questions.ask: What was the result?
questions.simple: What happened in the end?

questions.ask: Looking back, what did you learn from it?
questions.simple: What did you learn?

phrases.say: At that time, we were facing ...
My task was to ...
So I decided to ...
As a result, ...
It reduced / improved ... by ...
Looking back, I learned that ...

units.title: Disagreeing with a teammate (STAR)
units.scenario: A behavioural job interview about a disagreement with a colleague.
units.goal: Trả lời theo STAR. Nhấn mạnh cách bạn lắng nghe, dùng dữ liệu để thuyết phục, và vẫn giữ quan hệ tốt.
units.closing: Thanks, that's a good example of working with others.
units.vocab: teammate, tech lead, product owner, disagreement, opinion, approach, compromise, pros and cons, meeting, decision, proof of concept, benchmark.

questions.ask: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. What was it about?
questions.simple: Did you ever have a different opinion from a teammate? What happened?

questions.ask: How did you share your opinion with them?
questions.simple: What did you say to them?

questions.ask: How did you reach a decision in the end?
questions.simple: What did you both decide?

questions.ask: How was your relationship with that person afterwards?
questions.simple: Were you still on good terms after that?

questions.ask: What would you do differently next time?
questions.simple: What did you learn from it?

phrases.say: We had different opinions about ...
I understand your point, but ...

units.title: Working under a tight deadline (STAR)
units.scenario: A behavioural job interview about working under time pressure.
units.goal: Trả lời theo STAR: bạn ưu tiên việc gì, báo cho ai biết sớm, và kết quả có kịp hạn không.
units.greeting: Let's talk about working under time pressure.
units.closing: Thank you, that shows how you handle pressure.
units.vocab: deadline, release, sprint, scope, priority, stakeholder, manager, client, overtime, hotfix, must-have, nice-to-have, estimate.

questions.ask: Tell me about a time you had a very tight deadline. What was the situation?
questions.simple: Did you ever have too little time for a task? What happened?

questions.ask: How did you decide what to do first?
questions.simple: Which tasks did you do first, and why?

questions.ask: Did you talk to your manager or the client about it?
questions.simple: Who did you tell about the problem?

questions.ask: Did you finish on time? What was the result?
questions.simple: What happened in the end?

questions.ask: What do you do now to avoid that kind of situation?
questions.simple: What do you do now to have enough time?

phrases.say: We only had ... to finish ...

Now I always ... at the start.

units.title: A mistake you learned from (STAR)
units.scenario: A behavioural job interview about a mistake the candidate made at work.
units.goal: Thừa nhận lỗi thẳng thắn, nói nguyên nhân gốc, bạn đã sửa thế nào, và bạn thay đổi gì sau đó. Không đổ lỗi cho người khác.
units.greeting: Everyone makes mistakes, so let's talk about one.
units.closing: Thank you for being honest, that's a valuable lesson.
units.vocab: mistake, bug, production, rollback, hotfix, root cause, postmortem, checklist, monitoring, alert, responsibility, configuration, migration.

questions.ask: Can you tell me about a mistake you made at work?
questions.simple: Think of one mistake at work. What went wrong?

questions.ask: What was the impact?
questions.simple: What problem did it cause?

questions.ask: How did you fix it, and what was the root cause?
questions.simple: What did you do after you found it?

questions.ask: What did you change afterwards so it would not happen again?
questions.simple: What do you do differently now?

phrases.say: I made a mistake when I ...

units.title: Salary, start date and your questions
units.scenario: The final part of a job interview: expectations, availability, and the candidate's questions. If the candidate asks about the company or the job, reply with a short, friendly, general answer.
units.goal: Nói mức lương mong muốn một cách lịch sự, khi nào bạn bắt đầu được, và hỏi lại nhà tuyển dụng một câu hỏi hay.
units.greeting: We're almost done, just a few practical questions.
units.closing: Thank you for your time today. We'll get back to you within a week.
units.vocab: salary, expectation, gross, net, notice period, start date, remote, hybrid, onsite, benefits, probation, team size, onboarding, career path.

questions.ask: What are your salary expectations?
questions.simple: How much salary do you want?

questions.ask: When would you be able to start?
questions.simple: When can you start the new job?

questions.ask: Would you prefer to work remotely, in the office, or hybrid?
questions.simple: Do you want to work from home or in the office?

questions.ask: Do you have any questions for us?
questions.simple: Is there anything you want to ask me about the job?

phrases.say: Based on my experience, I'm expecting around ...
